units: <cite ref="Tosefta Bava Metzia 9:24">Tosef. B. Mets. IX, 24</cite> <he>בשעת הנ׳</he> (read: <he>בשנת</he>) in the year during which he cleared the land.
<cite ref="Mishnah Peah 2:1">Peah II, 1</cite> <he>הבור והנ׳</he> fallow land or newly broken land.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Nazir 7:1:21">Y. Naz. VII, 56ᵇ</cite> top; a. e.—Pl. <he>נִירִין</he>.
